guideline_title: In Vitro Skin Sensitisation: Assays addressing the Adverse Outcome Pathway key event on keratinocyte activation
note: One record per test method, with the source guideline as a property. Every field carries the guideline's own sentence and the paragraph it came from; see docs/oecd-tg-extraction.md and the extract-tg-method skill. Biology and materials come first in each record -- what is measured, in what cell or tissue, through what construct, and which chemistry the method can and cannot see. Performance is split by comparator because a figure measured against the LLNA is not a figure measured against human data.

method_family.value: ARE-Nrf2 luciferase reporter assay (one of three in this guideline)
method_family.quote: The test methods currently described in this Test Guideline include three in vitro ARE-Nrf2 luciferase test methods and two test methods based on gene expression quantification

measurement_basis.value: Transgenic luciferase reporter, not an endogenous transcript
measurement_basis.quote: by assessing with the help of luciferase, the Nrf2-mediated activation of antioxidant response element (ARE)-dependent genes

key_event.quote: addresses the second key event of the skin sensitisation AOP (1), namely keratinocytes activation

mechanism.value: Electrophile modification of Keap1 releases Nrf2, which activates ARE-dependent genes
mechanism.quote: Small electrophilic substances such as skin sensitisers can act on the sensor protein Keap1 (Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1), by e.g. covalent modification of its cysteine residue, resulting in its dissociation from the transcription factor Nrf2

initiating_chemistry.value: Electrophilic reaction with the cysteine sulfhydryl groups of Keap1
initiating_chemistry.quote: the key mechanism leading to the activation of the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway appears to be the electrophilic reaction of stressors with nucleophilic thiols (cysteine sulfhydryl groups) of Keap-1

host_cell_line.value: Immortalised adherent cell line derived from human keratinocytes
host_cell_line.quote: an immortalised adherent cell line derived from human keratinocytes

regulatory_element.value: Antioxidant response element of the human AKR1C2 gene
regulatory_element.quote: under the control of the antioxidant response element of the human AKR1C2 gene

reporter_construct.value: Luciferase under the ARE of the human AKR1C2 gene
reporter_construct.quote: stably harbouring a luciferase reporter gene under the control of the antioxidant response element of the human AKR1C2 gene

readout.quote: This allows quantitative measurement (by luminescence detection) of luciferase gene induction

exposure_route.value: Test chemical dissolved or dispersed in the exposure medium
exposure_route.quote: The test method is applicable to test chemicals soluble or that form a stable dispersion in the exposure medium

metabolic_competence.value: Limited metabolic capability of the cell line used
metabolic_competence.quote: because of the limited metabolic capability of the cell line used

prohapten_detection.value: Pro-haptens and pre-haptens with slow oxidation may read negative
prohapten_detection.quote: pro-haptens (i.e. chemicals requiring enzymatic activation for example via P450 enzymes) and pre-haptens (i.e. chemicals activated by auto-oxidation) in particular with a slow oxidation rate may also provide negative results

mechanistic_blind_spot.quote: substances with an exclusive reactivity towards lysine-residues can be detected as negative by the test method

assay_interference.value: Chemicals acting on luciferase itself, e.g. phytoestrogens above 1 uM
assay_interference.quote: test chemicals that interfere with the luciferase enzyme can confound the activity of luciferase in cell-based assays causing either apparent inhibition or increased luminescence

lipophilicity_limit.quote: mono constituent substances with a LogP above 7 may be insoluble in the exposure medium

mutual_acceptance_of_data.value: Guaranteed only for PS-validated methods reviewed and included in the TG by the OECD
mutual_acceptance_of_data.quote: Mutual Acceptance of Data (MAD) will only be guaranteed for test methods validated according to the PS, if these test methods have been reviewed and included in this Test Guideline by the OECD

Appendix IC describes EpiSensA and Epi2SensA together and separates them only in paragraphs IC/3 and IC/9. Both are introduced as 'proposed to address' key event 2, which is weaker than the 'addresses' used for the three luciferase methods; that wording is preserved in the key_event quote.

method_family.value: Gene expression quantification (one of two in this guideline)
method_family.quote: The test methods currently described in this Test Guideline include three in vitro ARE-Nrf2 luciferase test methods and two test methods based on gene expression quantification

measurement_basis.value: Direct quantification of four marker genes' expression
measurement_basis.quote: quantify changes in the expression of four marker genes associated with keratinocyte activation

key_event.quote: are proposed to address the second key event of the skin sensitisation Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) (1), namely keratinocyte activation

response_arms.value: Both the inflammatory and the cytoprotective keratinocyte response
response_arms.quote: Two important keratinocyte responses occur in the skin sensitisation AOP: the inflammatory responses and the induction of cytoprotective gene pathways

tissue_matrix.value: Three-dimensional reconstructed human epidermis at an air-liquid interface
tissue_matrix.quote: as RhE represents a three-dimensional model involving an air-liquid interface, test chemicals are applied directly to the surface of the RhE model

marker_genes.quote: ATF3, IL-8, GCLM, and DNAJB4) expression are quantified using Reverse Transcription-quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR)

marker_gene_interpretation.value: ATF3 and IL-8 report the inflammatory response; GCLM and DNAJB4 the cytoprotective response
marker_gene_interpretation.quote: Expression of the activating transcription factor 3 (ATF3) and interleukin-8 (IL-8) genes reflects the inflammatory response of keratinocytes, whereas expression of the glutamate-cysteine ligase modifier subunit (GCLM) and DnaJ (Hsp40) homolog subfamily B (DNAJB4) genes reflects the induction of cytoprotective gene pathways

exposure_route.quote: test chemicals are applied directly to the surface of the RhE model

metabolic_limit.quote: pro-haptens or pre-haptens that require more than 6 hours to be sufficiently metabolised or oxidised may not be detected by the EpiSensA and the Epi2SensA
